verdicts.decision_note: The client defines executable referral-ticket issuance, independent Small and Big Block ticket cycles, post-draw resets, and exclusion of secondary sales from ticket generation.
Removing Big Blocks necessarily eliminates the existing Big Block ticket count and lifecycle attributes while leaving Small Block referral-ticket issuance active.
The client specifies that each referral ticket is added to the referrer's NFT and associated on-chain with the wallet and mint number.
The client makes an already-minted NFT code the validation condition for routing the referral prize ticket to the selected referrer.
First concrete verification that a successful mint using referral code #4 credited the referred NFT with a prize ticket.
